faces.name: Discordant Dirge
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a verse counter on this enchantment.
{B}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Look at target opponent's hand and choose up to X cards from it, where X is the number of verse counters on this enchantment. That player discards those cards.

faces.name: Discordant Piper
faces.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 0/1 white Goat creature token.

faces.name: Discordant Spirit
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of each end step, if it's an opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each 1 damage dealt to you this turn.
At the beginning of your end step, remove all +1/+1 counters from this creature.

faces.name: Discord, Lord of Disharmony
faces.oracleText:
Flying
At the beginning of your end step, choose a random nonland Magic card name. Until your next end step, you may cast a copy of a spell with that name, and mana of any type can be spent to cast it. If you cast a spell this way, copy this ability if Discord is on the battlefield.

faces.name: Discourtesy Clerk
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more Attractions, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

faces.name: Discover the Formula
faces.oracleText: Seek three nonland cards, then nonland cards in your hand perpetually gain "This spell costs {1} less to cast."

faces.name: Discover the Impossible
faces.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. Exile one of them face down and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost if it's an instant spell with mana value 2 or less. If you don't, put that card into your hand.

faces.name: Discovery
faces.oracleText: Surveil 2, then draw a card. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

faces.name: Dispersal
faces.oracleText: Each opponent returns a nonland permanent they control with the greatest mana value among permanents they control to its owner's hand, then discards a card.
